findings.title: UI layer contains workflow orchestration
findings.summary: The returns exceptions page already mixes workflow branching into the UI layer and should not absorb more orchestration.
suggested_remediation: Move branching workflow into an action or service layer.
Keep the page focused on state binding and event dispatch.

findings.title: Returns filters use duplicated access logic
findings.summary: Adjacent returns workflow code already duplicates API access setup instead of using a shared integration seam.
suggested_remediation: Route remote access through the agreed abstraction for returns integrations.

findings.title: Returns work package evidence is incomplete
findings.summary: Recent returns work has missing review evidence files, so new changes in the same area should preserve a clear evidence trail.
suggested_remediation: Add explicit review findings and test evidence for each work package.
